name: dev.herofold/herofold
title: Herofold
description: Finished landing pages, blocks and Motion components, with the prompt, DESIGN.md and code for each

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Herofold's finished landing pages, blocks (sections cut from those pages), AI Motion components and Chat Lab dashboards. Plain language works for pages ("a calm dentist page in Dubai"), read the way herofold.dev's own search reads it. Filter by type (page, block, motion, chat), industry, region, category, plan (free or pro) and theme (light or dark). Results are grouped by type, each with its id, plan, page address and cover image. Call list_categories for the filter values.

query.description: Plain words: what the business does, where it is, how it should look, or the part you need

type.description: Only these kinds. Leave out for all four, grouped

items.description: page, block, motion or chat (Chat Lab)

industry.description: Page industry key or name, for example health, finance, software (list_categories)

region.description: Region, flavor or continent key, for example uae, japan, uk-experience, africa

category.description: Block category or group (hero, pricing, pricing-sections), Motion category, set or topic (thinking, essentials), or page type (saas, app-waitlist)

plan.description: free: everything opens through this server now

theme.description: Only items with a light or a dark look, in every kind

limit.description: Per kind. Default 5 when several kinds, 10 for one

offset.description: Skip this many results in each kind to see the next page; each group says its total

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Everything about one item: what it is, its palette and fonts, region and industry, plan, the Herofold page to preview it, its cover image, the blocks cut from it and related items, and which files (prompt, DESIGN.md, code) open on the free plan. Give the id from search; the type is optional.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, block id, Motion id or Chat Lab slug

type.description: page, block, motion or chat (Chat Lab)

tools.name: get_prompt
tools.description: The prompt that rebuilds an item, written from its built files: the master prompt for a page, the block prompt for a block, the component prompt for a Motion component, the dashboard prompt for Chat Lab. Free items return the whole prompt; Pro items return the opening lines and how to open the rest.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, block id, Motion id or Chat Lab slug

type.description: page, block, motion or chat (Chat Lab)

tools.name: get_design_md
tools.description: The DESIGN.md of a page or Chat Lab dashboard: colour tokens, type, spacing, components and the rules that keep new sections on brand, every value read from the built files. A block returns the DESIGN.md of the page it was cut from. Motion components carry their design in the prompt instead.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, block id, Motion id or Chat Lab slug

type.description: page, block, motion or chat (Chat Lab)

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: The finished code. A Motion component comes as plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript (format "single" for one HTML file, "files" for three). A block comes as its self-contained code.html. A whole page or Chat Lab dashboard comes as one HTML file and is part of Herofold Pro. Photos and video are licensed for Herofold only, so the code expects your own media.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, block id, Motion id or Chat Lab slug

type.description: page, block, motion or chat (Chat Lab)

format.description: Motion only: one HTML file (default) or three files

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The ways into the library with counts: page industries, regions and their flavors, page types and art directions; block categories and groups; Motion sets, topics and categories; and the Chat Lab dashboards. Use the keys as search filters.

type.description: Only this kind. Leave out for all
